notes.title: (This isn't your typical) PATCH!!!
notes.notes:
Patches are mostly about fixes, but not this one! We added some polish, sure, but it's secondary. Mostly achievement tweaks and some minor fixes. No, this is about giving you what you asked.

With this patch, Liberated now supports a wider array of resolutions, and the AZERTY keyboard scheme!

Even if you want to play the game in ultra widescreen, now it's not a problem. You don't have to try to force it or apply some mod. Liberated natively supports screens up to 32:9!

Is there anything else you'd like to see added? We'll do our best to deliver. Leave us a comment below. Also, did you like our game? We'll be grateful if you leave a Steam review!

Until next time. Keep fighting!

notes.title: PC PREMIERE INFODROP: Trailer, release date & FREE DLC
notes.notes:
BIG news, y'all! LIBERATED will land on your PC on July 30, and full of NEW STUFF to make the experience more yummy than ever. 

Here's exactly what you can expect.

[previewyoutube=rmXNeJEZWE8;full][/previewyoutube]

1. Boost in presentation.

 Ultra HD resolution support. (4K and up)
 Ultra widescreen support.
 High refresh rate support. (144Hz and up)
 High-res textures.
 Enhanced lighting.

2. Boost in gameplay.

Support for Keyboard & Mouse + Gamepads.
Various improvements to the game flow.

3. TWO FREE DLC CHAPTERS!

FOR THE HOMELAND tells the story of a low-level official tasked with directing the public discourse online. As a ‘paid troll,’ he destroys the lives and careers of targeted people while treating it like a nine-to-five job.

GLORY TO THE HEROES shows how the government and the media twist the narrative about the events presented in the base game. 

4. Full English voice-over to max your immersion.

Here's what core Nintendo press had to say about Liberated.


 “An atmospheric, absorbing treat” - 8/10, Nintendo Life
 “More than just a game” - 8/10, NintendoSoup
 “An incredibly well-crafted game that executes both story and gameplay excellently” - 9/10, Pure Nintendo
 “A standout title, both experimental and engrossing” - 9/10, Nintendo Enthusiast
 “Fine example of how games can enhance storytelling” - 84%, Switchaboo


Your PC version of the game will come enriched and with extra polish. We can't wait to let you play it!
